# THE CYMATICS INSTRUMENT

*What the bench is for: sealed by the architect's ruling, 2026-07-16.*

---

## I. THE RULING

The bench is the **instrument, not the reading**.

The card faces stay knots: the knots speak for themselves, as first ruled and
now re-affirmed. No cymatic layer joins a reading, a face, or a spread without
a further ruling. The experiment that led here was honest and is kept: laying
the figure under the knot showed that under path A they are **one number drawn
twice** (|q| petals over |q| spokes) and a restatement adds busyness, not
meaning. The uncertainty that surfaced was signal. The instrument now stands
where it belongs: beside the deck, not on it.

What follows is what the instrument is actually for.

---

## II. WHAT THE INSTRUMENT IS

A derivation pipeline and its witnesses. Nothing stored, nothing tuned:

- **The bridge** (`spatial/app/luminara-cymatics.js`): canon → mode spectrum.
  Path A (the interval, the sealed direction: the figure is the knot's
  number) and path B (the composition: kept on the toggle for comparison).
  Clarity is the interval's consonance; the Seed alone is unstruck, and its
  plate is empty: no sand is poured on silence.
- **Two renderers, one contract**: the sand plate (`luminara-sand.js`, grains
  kicked where the plate is loud, settling where it is still; the figure drawn
  by what does not move) and the glow field (`coherence-glyph.js`: the same
  field read luminously). Peter's cymatics engine is renderer two-proper and
  consumes the identical spectrum unchanged.
- **The pins** (`core/tests/luminaraCymatics.test.ts`): the discovered
  correspondences, made enforceable: 22 tests, including the full
  associativity sweep of the meet (sealed 2026-07-16).
- **The bench** (`spatial/app/luminara-cymatics.html`): the deck as a live
  resonance chart, the detail row (card · counter · meeting · becoming), and
  the meet laboratory.

---

## III. THE SEATS: WHAT IT IS FOR

### 1. The teaching chart

The fastest way into the grammar that exists. A student who knows nothing sees,
in one screen: the three houses as metal bands; weather-families as visible
kinships (every card of one interval settles into a family-resembling figure);
the locked consonances snapping crisp while the far dissonance trembles and
never lands. "Scar and Return are the far stations" stops being a sentence to
memorise and becomes something the eye already knows. The two-audience rule is
fulfilled without a word: the musician reads ratios; the untrained eye reads
rest and restlessness. A future appendix of the Illustrated Guide can draw on
this chart; the chart itself stays off the cards.

### 2. The proving ground

Enforcement over declaration, made visible. Every figure is a pure function of
the sealed canon, so the instrument is a **drift detector**: if any future
change to the derivations breaks a symmetry, a figure visibly changes and a
pin loudly fails. The correspondences the bridge revealed: counters as one
figure spinning opposite ways; the kinship of opposites as their shared
silence; Void and Spectrum as the only struck figures at full clarity; exactly
the three link-dyads carrying a reduced voice: are all pinned. The instrument
is where the canon proves itself to the eye as well as to the test runner.

### 3. The study of motion: the fourth dimension's rehearsal room

The one thing the sand can say that the knot structurally cannot: **time**.
A knot is form; the plate is form in time: settling, trembling, refusing to
land, freezing when the bow lifts. The becoming morphs live here: a card
breathing into its becoming, and the cadence home played physically: the
field quieting, the last figure frozen on a silent plate, the truest image of
the Return the system has produced. If cymatics ever re-approach a reading, it
will be through this door only: motion in the Phi position, the resolution
seen rather than stated: and only by the architect's ruling. Until then this
seat is where that grammar is developed, tuned, and understood.

### 4. The meet laboratory

The algebra of the deck, witnessed. THE MEET (layerwise addition on the
ladder's own arithmetic: **sealed by the architect, 2026-07-16**) makes the deck a group of
order twenty-seven: the Seed the identity, every counter an inverse, any two
cards meeting in a third, every card thrice-met with itself coming home. The
lab is where that structure is seen rather than asserted: Scar ⊕ Return pours
out to an empty plate. The meet was sealed here: the lab is where it
earned its place before the architect named it canon.

### 5. The dock: the handoff to Peter

The spectrum contract (`modes {n, m, w, phase, motion} · clarity · struck ·
gain`) is renderer-agnostic by construction. The bench is the **reference
implementation and acceptance surface**: Peter's engine, pointed at the same
contract, should reproduce the same nodal counts, the same rest and
restlessness, the same empty plate for the Seed. Divergence between his
renderer and this one localises a bug immediately: either in his physics or
in a derivation, never ambiguously. The instrument is the fixture his engine
docks against.

### 6. The kinship instrument: one visual language for the organism

The figures speak the same language as the coherence glyph: identities, bonds
(the Forge's two-spectra harmony), and now cards, all render as modes of one
field. That shared language is a door held, not a feature shipped: a person's
figure and a card's figure could one day be compared: **as a mirror, never a
score**: but only if the person's figure is itself canon-grounded, and only
under the Interpreter's Law. The Living Cube's heat and drift maps could also
render cymatically: the manifold's stillness and restlessness as one plate.
Held seats, named here so they are chosen deliberately or not at all.

### 7. The sounding seat (held)

The intervals are literal frequency ratios. The instrument is the natural
place to one day *hear* the deck, 3:2 agreeing with itself while the sand
rests; 13:7 refusing to land while it trembles, the figure and the tone as
one lesson. Audio is unbuilt on purpose: it joins when it earns its place,
and it joins here first, never on a card.

### 8. The attunement object (held, railed)

A plate settling to stillness is a natural focus object: kin to the Living
Cube's teaching that the tool resolves once the water is found. A breath, an
attention, a sitting, paced by sand coming to rest at clarity 1. This seat is
named so that if it is ever built, it is built deliberately, with the rails
on: an aid to attention, never a measure of the person attending.

---

## IV. THE RAILS: WHAT IT IS NOT FOR

- **Not the card faces.** The knots speak for themselves. Standing ruling.
- **Not a reading layer.** No figure joins a spread today; the motion seat
  (III.3) is the only candidate door, and it stays shut without a ruling.
- **Not a verdict.** Figures describe; they never operate, predict, or judge.
  Clarity is a property of an interval, not of a person asking a question.
- **Not a score.** No consonance between a person and a card is computed or
  shown while person-figures remain hash-derived rather than canon-grounded,
  and if that ever changes, the result is a mirror under the Interpreter's
  Law, never a number presented as worth.

---

*Derived, never tuned. The figure is an instrument, not a verdict.*
